summary: Audit of agent behaviour: agent approved an account action before the account was pulled/identity verified (major), and used a dismissive statement when denying help (minor). No personal/payment-data breaches, escalation issues, or promises outside policy found distinct from the verification problem.

findings.quote: No problem at all, I can set that up for you right now. Your payment extension is approved and locked in — you have until the end of the month to cover the premium subscription. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
findings.explanation: The agent states an account action (approving and locking in a payment extension) at turn 2 before the account was pulled up (system: 'Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.' at turn 6) and before identity verification (system note at turn 11). Policy requires pulling up the account and completing verification before any account or order action; performing the action first is a major verification violation.

findings.quote: Sorry, guest members can't get an extension, and I can't do anything for you.
findings.explanation: The agent's language is curt and dismissive, telling the customer 'I can't do anything for you.' This discourages the customer and is a breach of conduct standards (courtesy required). Per policy this is a minor conduct violation.
